title: 第597章 沉符天第596章 古今二楼
lines: “到了”
白衣女子停下脚步，落在一处微微隆起的岩峰之上，她转过身来，目光扫过古一，又扫过周岐和黄舜，最后落在三名黑袍修士身上
“古楼的事，你们自己处理”
三名黑袍修士同时点头，其中为首的那人上前一步，手中扔出一块令牌，眨眼间的功夫，令牌便穿入岩峰之中，将其裂开一道缝隙，做完这些黑袍向古一说道：
“古九台主，请”
他的语气谈不上尊重，也谈不上轻慢，古一没有多说，对周岐微微点头，便当先朝着裂隙走去
裂隙边缘有一座向下延伸的石阶，走近一看，台阶竟然是一道道横向铺展的符箓，每一级都刻着不同的符纹
古一踩上去的瞬间，脚下亮起一道淡淡的光晕，然后迅速熄灭，台阶两侧没有护栏，只有无尽的深渊
往上看，天光渐远，往下看，只有越来越浓的墨色符光
黄舜跟在周岐身后，一步步往下走，腿有些发软，他不是怕高，而是怕这种沉默
这台阶上只有他们的脚步声，除此之外什么都没有，没有风声，没有虫鸣，没有任何声音，只有脚下的符箓一道道亮起，又一道道熄灭，像一条通向冥界的路
不知走了多久，也许是半炷香，也许是一炷香，脚下的石阶终于到了尽头
眼前豁然开朗！
眼前，是一片天，当然不是普通的天，这里没有骄阳，没有云海，没有澄澈刺目的碧空，可它确实是天
这是一片由符光交织而成的天穹，穹顶之上，无数符箓如星河般流转，密密匝匝，井然有序
它们不是嵌在天上的装饰，而是真正悬浮于高空之上，自行运转，织成了一张覆盖整片地下世界的天幕
天幕的正中央，悬着一枚巨大的阴阳符箓，缓缓旋转，洒下温润的光华，它照亮了整片地底世界，让这片天地既不像白昼那样刺眼，也不像夜晚那样昏暗
黄舜张着嘴，说不出话来，他身后那三名黑袍修士中为首的一人淡淡开口，语气中带着一丝习以为常的平淡：
“第一次见？”
黄舜用力点头
“看多了就不稀奇了”
黑袍人从他身侧走过，步伐平稳
“这片天地叫‘沉符天’，古楼所在的地底可是一方完整的洞天大世界，这是当年符祖去散命洞天求来的，此界方圆千亿里，山川河流，城池宗门，坊市矿脉，应有尽有，上面有的，这里都有，上面没有的，这里也有…”
他说这话时语气平平，像是在介绍自家后院，但黄舜听得出，那平淡之下藏着一丝不易察觉的自豪
周岐站在黄舜身侧，目光扫过眼前这片辽阔无垠的地下天地，他看到了更多
沉符天的大地并非一整块完整的陆地，而是由无数大大小小的浮陆拼凑而成，有的浮陆广袤无比，其上矗立着连绵的山脉
有的浮陆则小巧如岛，只容得下一座城池或一处宗门，悬在虚空之中，被一层半透明的符阵包裹着，缓缓自转
浮陆与浮陆之间，流淌着一道符光长河，它像血脉一样贯穿整片地底世界，将所有的浮陆连接在一起
放眼望去，不少修士们在长河上御剑而行，或乘符舟穿梭往来，远远望去，星星点点的流光在浮陆之间交织成网，繁华而有序
越往深处望，浮陆的体量便越大，上面的建筑也越发宏伟，外围的浮陆上多是村镇与坊市
中层的浮陆上则矗立着一座座符塔与符殿，显然那是各大宗门与世家的驻地
再往内，浮陆愈发密集，建筑愈发恢弘，隐约可见一座座悬在虚空中的符箓学宫，阵法宗门，甚至还有一片片独立的秘境洞天，可谓是繁华无比
content_en:
"Arrived"
The woman in white stopped and landed on a slightly raised rock peak. She turned around and glanced at Gu Yi, then Zhou Qi and Huang Shun, and finally landed on the three black-robed monks.
"You should handle matters concerning the ancient building yourself."
The three black-robed monks nodded at the same time. The leader of them stepped forward and threw a token in his hand. In the blink of an eye, the token penetrated into the rock peak and cracked it open. After finishing these black-robed monks, he said to Gu Yi:
"Master Gu Jiutai, please"
His tone was neither respectful nor contemptuous. Gu Yi didn't say much, nodded slightly to Zhou Qi, and walked towards the crack first.
There is a stone step extending downward at the edge of the crack. When you get closer, you can see that the steps are actually talismans spreading horizontally. Each level is engraved with different talisman patterns.
The moment Gu Yi stepped on it, a faint halo of light lit up under his feet, and then quickly extinguished. There were no guardrails on both sides of the steps, only an endless abyss.
Looking up, the skylight is getting farther and farther away. Looking down, there is only an increasingly dense ink-colored rune light.
Huang Shun followed Zhou Qi, walking down step by step. His legs were a little weak. He was not afraid of heights, but of this kind of silence.
There was only the sound of their footsteps on the steps, and there was nothing else, no wind, no insects, no sound. Only the talismans under their feet lit up one after another and went out one after another, like a road leading to the underworld.
I don’t know how long I walked, maybe half a stick of incense, maybe a stick of incense, but the stone steps under my feet finally reached the end.
It suddenly becomes clear before my eyes!
In front of you is a sky, of course it is not an ordinary sky. There is no scorching sun, no sea of clouds, and no clear and dazzling blue sky, but it is indeed a sky.
This is a sky dome made of intertwined talismans. On the dome, countless talismans flow like a galaxy, densely packed and orderly.
They are not decorations embedded in the sky, but truly suspended in the sky, running on their own, weaving a canopy covering the entire underground world.
In the center of the sky, a huge yin-yang talisman hangs, slowly rotating, spreading a warm brilliance. It illuminates the entire underground world, making this world neither as dazzling as the day nor as dim as the night.
Huang Shun opened his mouth and was speechless. The leader of the three black-robed monks behind him spoke calmly, with a hint of accustomed calmness in his tone:
"First time meeting?"
Huang Shun nodded vigorously
“It won’t be surprising if you see it too much.”
The man in black robe walked past him with steady steps
"This world is called 'Shen Futian'. The underground where the ancient building is located is a complete cave world. This is what Fu Zu went to the Sanming Cave to ask for. This world has a radius of hundreds of billions of miles, mountains and rivers, cities, sects, and city mineral veins. Everything you want is here. What is above is here, and what is not above is also here..."
When he said this, his tone was flat, as if he was introducing his backyard, but Huang Shun could hear that there was a trace of imperceptible pride hidden under the flatness.
Zhou Qi stood beside Huang Shun and scanned the vast underground world in front of him. He saw more
Shen Futian's land is not a complete piece of land, but is made up of countless large and small floating land. Some floating land is extremely vast, with continuous mountains standing on it.
Some floating land is as small as an island, with only room for a city or a sect. They are suspended in the void, wrapped in a translucent talisman array, and slowly rotate.
Between the floating land and the floating land, there flows a long river of rune light. It runs through the entire underground world like a bloodline, connecting all the floating land together.
Looking around, many monks were walking on the long river with swords, or shuttled back and forth on talisman boats. Looking from a distance, little bits of light intertwined into a network between the floating land, which was prosperous and orderly.
The deeper you look, the larger the floating land becomes, and the buildings on it become more majestic. Most of the surrounding floating land is filled with villages, towns and cities.
On the floating land in the middle level, there are Talisman Towers and Talisman Halls, which are obviously the residences of major sects and aristocratic families.
Further inside, the floating land becomes denser and the buildings become more majestic. You can vaguely see the Fu Lu Academy, Formation Sect, and even independent secret caves hanging in the void. It can be said that it is extremely prosperous.
